title: Reconcile
description: Match every bank line to the books. Ledger suggests; anything that records money is proposed to you first.

actions.label: Reconcile all
actions.ask: Reconcile all unmatched bank lines: match receipts and payments to their invoices and bills, code the rest with our coding rules, and tell me which lines you could not place.

row_actions.label: Match
row_actions.ask: Record the matching settlement for {{row.suggestions.documents.0.kind}} {{row.suggestions.documents.0.number}} ({{row.suggestions.documents.0.party}}) using bank line {{row.id}} ({{row.date}}, "{{row.description}}", {{row.amount_minor|money_exact}} on account {{row.bank_account_code}}).

row_actions.label: Code it
row_actions.ask: Categorize bank line {{row.id}} ({{row.date}}, "{{row.description}}", {{row.amount_minor|money_exact}}) to account {{row.suggestions.rule.account_code}} as the coding rule suggests.

row_actions.label: Find match
row_actions.ask: Find the right match for bank line {{row.id}} ({{row.date}}, "{{row.description}}", {{row.amount_minor|money_exact}}). If it settles an invoice or bill, record that; otherwise suggest the account and ask me.
